instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer, step 2 — must be signed by the proposed admin.

instructions.name: apply_config_update
docs: Timelocked config change, step 2. PERMISSIONLESS: the params and eta were fixed
and published when queued, so anyone may execute once `now >= eta` (and before
eta + grace). The admin cannot time a known change opportunistically, and a
change everyone has been warned about cannot be withheld; the admin keeps
`cancel_config_update` as the veto.

instructions.name: apply_splitter_update
docs: Timelocked splitter change, step 2. PERMISSIONLESS after eta (within the grace window).

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy with an exact SOL budget. Charges less if capped by remaining supply.

instructions.name: cancel_config_update
docs: Admin veto for a queued config change (also the only way to drop a stale one).

instructions.name: cancel_splitter_update
docs: Admin veto for a queued splitter change.

instructions.name: create_token
docs: Creates a fixed-supply mint, its metadata, and the bonding curve that sells it.
The creator chooses the token's reward terms, both immutable: `reward_model`
(0 Standard, 1 Creator, 2 Holder) and `reward_bps`, the reward rate charged on every
buy and sell on top of DEEP's protocol fee, on this curve and later on the token's
DeepSwap pool. Standard: `reward_bps` must be 0. Creator / Holder: at least 1, at
most the admin's current maximum (`Config.max_reward_bps`, itself at most the hard
ceiling `math::MAX_REWARD_BPS`, 500), and DEEP's protocol fee plus the reward rate at
most 1000 bps on each side. They are stored on the curve together with DEEP's protocol
rates in force now; later changes of the maximum or of the rates never touch it.
`max_launch_fee_lamports`: the most the creator agrees to pay as launch fee. The fee is
set in USD and converted at the Pyth SOL/USD price inside this instruction; if that
comes to more lamports than this limit the transaction fails with `LaunchFeeAboveMax`
and nothing is charged (security review F9).

accounts.name: price_update
docs: verification level, staleness and confidence are checked in the handler (only
when the launch fee is non-zero).

instructions.name: distribute
docs: PERMISSIONLESS: unwraps the vault's WSOL, pays the builder exactly 10% of all revenue
over time and the rest to the configured destinations by bps. Destinations follow in
`remaining_accounts`, writable, in config order.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Fronts the rent of the temporary WSOL-unwrap account when the vault holds WSOL
and gets exactly that back in the same instruction; pays nothing else and receives
nothing else.

accounts.name: builder
docs: account (e.g. a Squads vault PDA); the handler pays it only while it is one and
otherwise books its share as `builder_owed`.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Graduates a completed curve into a deep-amm (DeepSwap CPMM) pool, non-custodially:
the pool is created via CPI with `lp_sol` (as WSOL) and `lp_tokens` from
`math::graduation_allocation`, every LP token received is burned (permanent
lock), and reserve tokens not needed for the pool are burned.
DEEP V1: when the configured AmmConfig is a V1 config the pool is created through
deep-amm `initialize_with_permission_v1` with the token's immutable reward model and
reward rate (`curve.reward_model`, `curve.creator_fee_bps`: the same rate the curve
charged) and SOL as its quote: every DeepSwap fee of the pool is taken in
SOL, and the reward part (Creator / Holder tokens) accrues for `reward_recipient`, the
token's creator or the token's holder vault, which is recorded as the pool's
`pool_creator`. A Holder token's curve reward fees are swept to its holder vault here
when the vault can hold them (same rule as `sweep_holder_fees`; skipped, never failed,
otherwise, and they stay sweepable). When the configured AmmConfig is still a legacy
one, the pool is created through `initialize_with_permission` exactly as before V1
(the AmmConfig's creator fee, in SOL), with the same `reward_recipient`.
PERMISSIONLESS (security review F2): a completed curve's SOL has no other way out, so
no key can withhold it. The instruction has no signer account at all; whoever sends
the transaction pays its network fee and nothing else, and receives nothing. Every
account is pinned by seeds or address, and every lamport and token has a fixed
destination: the pool (LP burned), the burn, the reward recipient's holder vault
(a Holder token's curve fees) and the DEEP fee vault (everything else: the
migration fee minus the pool costs, the rent of the two temporary token accounts,
SOL or WSOL anyone donated to them or to `pool_creator`). `Config.migration_authority`
is not read. deep-amm cannot be made to refuse the pool: for this payer it needs no
`Permission`, ignores `disable_create_pool` and caps the create-pool fee.
Pool creation costs (deep-amm create-pool fee + rent, and the temporary accounts'
rent until they are closed here) are paid out of the migration fee; the rest goes to
the DEEP fee vault. If the migration fee does not cover the costs, anyone can
top up the `pool_creator` PDA with SOL and retry (that PDA is shared by every
graduation, and each one sweeps what is left of it to the fee vault, so top up in
the same transaction or right before the retry). Idempotent: a second call
fails with `AlreadyGraduated`.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: The DEEP fee vault (DEEP V1; was the Treasury, same position).

accounts.name: reward_recipient
docs: (`reward_recipient_address`): the token's holder vault (deep-rewards PDA
`["holder_vault", mint]`) for a Holder token, the token's creator otherwise. Recorded
as the pool's `pool_creator`. Never signs. For a Holder token pass it WRITABLE so the
curve's holder fees can be swept to it here (read-only: that sweep is skipped); it
receives nothing else in this instruction.

accounts.name: creator_token
docs: missing (payer = `pool_creator`), verified (mint, owner) and closed in the same
instruction.

accounts.name: creator_wsol
docs: token program and deep-amm verify it when it is used.

accounts.name: permission
docs: It does not have to exist: deep-amm requires no permission from this payer.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time protocol setup. The signer becomes admin and must be this program's
upgrade authority (prevents front-running the config PDA after deploy).

instructions.name: initialize_splitter
docs: One-time (admin): creates the SplitterConfig with the initial 90% destinations, funds
the fee vault to its rent minimum and creates the vault's WSOL ATA (payer = admin).
Fails unless this build's deep-amm locks its protocol owner and create-pool fee receiver
to this vault.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: PERMISSIONLESS, idempotent: grows a v1 (213 B) or v2 (215 B) Config and, if present, a
v1 (165 B) or v2 (167 B) PendingConfig to the v3 layout. No-op when already v3.
New fields: the launch fee (v2) starts at 0; `sell_protocol_fee_bps` (v3) is set to the
account's own `protocol_fee_bps`, so sells keep paying what they paid before; the
current maximum reward rate (v3, `max_reward_bps`) starts at the ceiling, 500. Every
other value is then set through the timelock.

instructions.name: migrate_curve
docs: PERMISSIONLESS, idempotent: grows a v1 (177 B) or v2 (185 B) BondingCurve to v3 (196 B).
No-op when already v3. `protocol_fees_unclaimed` (v2) and `holder_fees_unclaimed` (v3)
start at 0. The v3 fee fields keep the token's economics unchanged:
`sell_protocol_fee_bps` = its `protocol_fee_bps`, and `reward_model` = Creator when it
charges a creator fee (which keeps accruing to the creator), otherwise Standard. The
payer funds the rent difference, so the curve stays solvent.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer, step 1.

instructions.name: queue_config_update
docs: Timelocked config change, step 1 (admin). Validates `params` now and stores them
with `eta = now + config.timelock_seconds` (the delay in force at queue time, so
shortening the timelock is itself delayed by the current timelock). Only one
change can be pending; cancel it first to replace it.

instructions.name: queue_splitter_update
docs: Timelocked splitter change, step 1 (admin). Delay = `Config.timelock_seconds`.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell an exact token amount for at least `min_sol_out` lamports.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency pause. Blocks create/buy/sell; does not block creator fee claims.

instructions.name: sweep_holder_fees
docs: PERMISSIONLESS: moves a Holder token's accrued curve reward fees to its holder vault,
the deep-rewards PDA `["holder_vault", mint]` (system-owned; deep-rewards pays them to
holders by Merkle claim). Works before and after graduation. The vault must end at or
above the 0-byte rent minimum: once `init_distributor` has run it always does; before
that, the call succeeds as soon as the accrued amount alone covers it. Until then the
fees stay on the curve, counted in `holder_fees_unclaimed`, never lost.

accounts.name: holder_vault
docs: The token's holder vault: the deep-rewards PDA `["holder_vault", mint]`, system-owned
and data-less (deep-rewards never allocates it). Any other account is rejected.

instructions.name: sweep_protocol_fees
docs: PERMISSIONLESS: moves a curve's accrued protocol fees (trade + launch) to the DEEP fee
vault, where `distribute` splits them (builder 10%, destinations 90%). Batched off the
hot path so buys/sells never write a global account.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: The DEEP fee vault (system-owned PDA, funded to its rent minimum by
`initialize_splitter`).

instructions.name: withdraw_protocol_fees
docs: Sends what is left in the legacy treasury PDA to `config.fee_recipient`. Admin only;
the treasury always stays rent-exempt. DEEP V1: nothing credits the Treasury any more
(all revenue goes to the fee vault); this only drains the pre-V1 devnet balance.

instructions.name: withdraw_vault_tokens
docs: Admin: moves non-WSOL tokens that reached the fee vault (legacy token-side DeepSwap
protocol fees) to a token account of `config.fee_recipient`. Outside the 10% split
(docs/V1_FEES.md Q12); WSOL can only leave through `distribute`.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Any SPL Token or Token-2022 mint except WSOL (WSOL is revenue and only leaves through
`distribute`).

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Fees are snapshotted at launch so config changes never affect live curves.

fields.name: pool
docs: deep-amm pool created at graduation (default until graduated). Appended field.

fields.name: protocol_fees_unclaimed
docs: Protocol fees (trade + launch) held on this PDA until sweep_protocol_fees.
Appended in v2.

fields.name: sell_protocol_fee_bps
docs: DEEP V1 (appended, v3). Protocol fee on SELLS, snapshotted at launch;
`protocol_fee_bps` is the BUY rate.

fields.name: reward_model
docs: 0 Standard, 1 Creator, 2 Holder (`math::REWARD_MODEL_*`). Chosen at `create_token`,
never changed afterwards. Graduation carries it into the DeepSwap pool (Phase 3).
`creator_fee_bps` is this token's reward rate on both sides.

fields.name: holder_fees_unclaimed
docs: Holder-model reward fees held on this PDA until `sweep_holder_fees`.

fields.name: migration_authority
docs: NO AUTHORITY ANY MORE (security review F2): `graduate` is permissionless and no
instruction reads this field. It is kept for layout compatibility and names, by
convention only, the key DEEP's own graduation crank signs with. It must still be
non-zero (`ConfigParams::validate`, unchanged).

fields.name: raydium_amm_config
docs: deep-amm AmmConfig that graduated pools are created under (appended field).

fields.name: timelock_seconds
docs: Delay for queued config changes, seconds (appended field).

fields.name: launch_fee_usd_cents
docs: Launch fee in US cents, priced in SOL via Pyth at create_token (appended, v2).
0 = no fee. Capped at MAX_LAUNCH_FEE_USD_CENTS.

fields.name: sell_protocol_fee_bps
docs: DEEP V1 (appended, v3). Protocol fee on SELLS; `protocol_fee_bps` is the BUY rate.

fields.name: max_reward_bps
docs: The CURRENT maximum reward rate a creator may choose at `create_token` (eighth round,
2026-10-07), at most the hard ceiling `math::MAX_REWARD_BPS` (500). Changed through the
config timelock. It applies to new launches only: a live curve keeps its rate, and
`graduate` never looks at it.

fields.name: reserved_bps
docs: RESERVED (v3 layout): stored, read by no instruction.

fields.name: timelock_seconds
docs: Delay applied to every later config change (0..=MAX_TIMELOCK_SECONDS).

fields.name: launch_fee_usd_cents
docs: Launch fee in US cents (0..=MAX_LAUNCH_FEE_USD_CENTS). Appended in v2.

fields.name: sell_protocol_fee_bps
docs: Appended in v3 (DEEP V1): sell-side protocol fee; `protocol_fee_bps` is the buy side.

fields.name: max_reward_bps
docs: Appended in v3: the current maximum reward rate for new launches (<= 500).

fields.name: reserved_bps
docs: Appended in v3. RESERVED: stored, read by no instruction.

fields.name: bps
docs: Share of the 90% remainder, bps of 10_000.

fields.name: owed
docs: Lamports due but not yet paid (the wallet would have stayed below rent exemption).

fields.name: paid_total
docs: Lamports paid to this wallet since it was added.

fields.name: price
docs: Pyth SOL/USD price · 10^exponent USD

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: The single queued config change (reused; `active` marks whether one is pending).

fields.name: eta
docs: Earliest unix time `apply_config_update` succeeds.

types.name: PendingSplitterUpdate
docs: The single queued splitter change (same timelock rules as `PendingConfig`).

types.name: RevenueDistributed
docs: One `distribute`. `base` is the NEW revenue of this round; `amounts[i]` is what wallet `i`
received (its share plus any previously owed lamports), `owed[i]` what it is still owed.

fields.name: builder_owed
docs: Builder pay still due (the wallet could not receive yet); paid on a later round.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of configured destinations (1..=8); `destinations[count..]` are zero.

fields.name: base_total
docs: Every lamport of revenue that has entered the split, ever.

fields.name: builder_paid_total
docs: Every lamport credited to the builder, ever (= floor(base_total / 10)); of it,
`builder_owed` may still be waiting to be transferred.

fields.name: retained
docs: Rounding dust of the 90% split, kept in the vault for the next round.

fields.name: min_distribute_lamports
docs: Minimum NEW revenue for a `distribute` (default 0.01 SOL, at most 10 SOL).

fields.name: destinations_paid_total
docs: Lamports paid to the 90% destinations, ever (removed destinations included).

fields.name: builder_owed
docs: Builder pay that is due (counted in `builder_paid_total`) but not yet transferred,
because the builder wallet would have stayed below rent exemption. Paid first on the
next `distribute` that can; never lost and never re-split.

fields.name: reward_model
docs: Appended (DEEP V1): 0 Standard, 1 Creator, 2 Holder.

fields.name: reward_bps
docs: Appended (DEEP V1, sixth round): the reward rate the creator chose, bps per side.

fields.name: reward_model
docs: Appended (DEEP V1). The token's reward model.

fields.name: holder_fee
docs: Appended (DEEP V1). The reward part of the fee when the model is Holder (then
`creator_fee` is 0); 0 otherwise. `protocol_fee + creator_fee + holder_fee` is the
whole fee of the trade.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Program-owned PDA that accrues protocol trade fees and migration fees.
